0539db78a15e.en: Can an AI chatbot price our job instead?

57a3edca0018.en: A chatbot on its own does not know what you pay: a 2024 university study found GPT-4's estimates were inaccurate and inconsistent until it was given real labour, plant and material rates. I-Cost keeps those real rates, your supplier quotes and purchase order prices, and its AI guide prices start from them, then your own suppliers' websites if you tick it. Each guide shows its range and where it came from, and nothing goes into the estimate until you press Use.

4dcdd39b74ea.en: No software can guarantee a saving. I-Cost gives you the figures early enough to act on them: what has been committed against the budget, what the forecast margin is, and which items are still waiting for prices or deliveries.
